articles.title: Surveillance and control efficacy of the Bergerac, France, 2025 chikungunya outbreak

en.research_question: How effectively did varying intensities and geographic scopes of vector control interventions influence the trajectory of a chikungunya outbreak in a French municipality?
en.study_design: The investigation utilized a climate-informed mathematical framework to simulate mosquito-borne virus transmission and compared simulated outputs against observed epidemiological records.
en.population_setting: The analysis focused on a 2025 chikungunya cluster in Bergerac, France, which emerged following introductions linked to international travel from an affected overseas territory.
en.main_findings: Early interventions restricted in scope and intensity demonstrated minimal capacity to curb transmission during periods of rapid viral spread. Conversely, expanded operational efforts alongside heightened community vigilance corresponded with a marked decline in reported infections.
en.public_health_relevance: The results indicate that aligning intervention magnitude with transmission severity and sustaining continuous monitoring are essential strategies for managing emerging arboviral threats in temperate regions.
en.gids_interpretation: This work contributes to the literature on computational approaches for forecasting arbovirus dynamics under changing environmental conditions. It provides methodological context for evaluating how response timing and resource allocation influence outbreak trajectories without implying current real-time monitoring status.

zh.research_question: 本研究基于数学建模方法，旨在量化评估法国贝热拉克市2025年基孔肯雅病毒疫情期间的监测网络与防控策略的实际作用。
zh.study_design: 研究采用气候驱动数学模型模拟伊蚊活动与病毒传播路径，并将模拟输出数据与实地报告的病例统计进行对照验证。
zh.population_setting: 研究场景位于法国多尔多涅省贝热拉克市，主要关注由海外领地旅客输入所触发的本地聚集性感染事件。
zh.main_findings: 模型推演表明，疫情首四周受限于干预半径与强度的早期措施未能有效压低发病规模；后期实施的广覆盖高强度管控配合公众认知提升，则促使感染人数大幅下降。
zh.public_health_relevance: 研究强调防控资源分配应与病毒扩散的地理广度及流行强度相匹配，并指出化学灭蚊与社区宣教协同应用可作为降低媒介传播疾病风险的有效途径。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该成果为区域卫生部门优化气候相关虫媒传染病预警机制提供了理论依据，其模型构建逻辑可辅助后续同类突发疫情的响应规划。

articles.title: Shared evidence, different recommendations: a comparative analysis of Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine guidance for travellers across countries

en.research_question: How do national advisory organizations differ in their policy recommendations for administering the Qdenga dengue vaccine to international travelers?
en.study_design: A comparative policy analysis that evaluated publicly accessible national guidelines alongside survey responses from health advisory committees.
en.population_setting: Public health advisory bodies representing seventeen nations, primarily non-endemic regions where the vaccine holds formal licensing approval.
en.main_findings: National directives consistently exceeded regulatory permissions in restrictiveness while demonstrating uniform support for individuals with confirmed past infections. Eligibility criteria for travelers lacking documented infection history showed substantial cross-border variation based on inconsistent application of exposure metrics and host susceptibility factors. Protocols also diverged regarding infection verification methods and pre-departure dosing schedules.
en.public_health_relevance: Inconsistent international protocols complicate clinical counseling and traveler preparedness for dengue-endemic destinations. Harmonizing future advisories will likely depend on supplementary effectiveness data targeting specific demographic groups currently underrepresented in clinical trials. Maintaining transparent dialogue between providers and patients remains critical amid these policy discrepancies.
en.limitations: The investigation synthesizes existing policy documents and committee surveys rather than measuring direct clinical outcomes or population-level vaccination coverage. Interpretive disparities stem from inherent differences between controlled trial cohorts and real-world travel demographics.
en.gids_interpretation: The manuscript demonstrates how identical foundational research can produce divergent regulatory pathways when expert panels navigate evidentiary gaps differently. It provides context for understanding guideline heterogeneity without implying changes in underlying pathogen circulation or novel safety signals.

zh.research_question: 该研究旨在系统对比不同国家针对旅行者使用Qdenga（TAK-003）疫苗的官方指导原则，并剖析各国咨询机构在推荐标准上的异同。
zh.study_design: 本研究采用横向比较设计，整合问卷调查结果与公开指南的结构化审查，对多国发布的旅行者疫苗接种建议进行政策比对。
zh.population_setting: 研究覆盖来自17个国家的18个公共卫生咨询机构，重点聚焦具有或无实验室确诊既往登革热感染史的旅行者群体。
zh.main_findings: 各国指导原则整体较监管授权更为保守。针对已确诊既往感染的旅行者，各机构推荐高度一致；但未明确感染史人群的推荐分歧较大。决策过程中对旅行时长、重复暴露及宿主因素的应用方式不一，部分机构仅限既往感染者接种，另一些则依据暴露风险放宽条件或强制要求出行前完成全程免疫。
zh.public_health_relevance: 研究凸显了跨国疫苗政策碎片化现状，强调在标准不一时应优先保障决策透明度并推行医患共同决策。同时指出需积累阴性旅行者及老年群体的有效性与安全性数据，以推动未来指南趋同。
zh.limitations: 现有资料存在数据空白，且临床试验受试者特征与实际旅行者群体存在差异。研究主要基于公开文本与问卷反馈，未能直接验证实际接种后的临床转归，各机构对证据不确定性的管理策略差异可能限制结论的广泛适用性。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献为公共卫生监测网络提供了关于登革热疫苗跨境政策协调性的背景参考。其内容有助于梳理各国在共享科学证据基础上形成差异化建议的内在逻辑，可为后续指南动态调整与资源配置提供结构化信息支撑。

articles.title: Strategic Preparedness for the FIFA World Cup 2026 in Response to the Bundibugoy Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo

en.research_question: How should international health authorities and tournament hosts formulate travel health strategies when a major global sporting event coincides with an emerging viral crisis lacking approved medical countermeasures?
en.study_design: This publication is a peer-reviewed journal article that presents a policy perspective and strategic recommendation rather than an empirical clinical or observational study.
en.population_setting: The analysis targets international travelers and attendees participating in large-scale cross-border mass gatherings.
en.main_findings: Existing host country measures, such as border restrictions and prolonged isolation mandates, lack strong epidemiological backing. The authors emphasize that standardized, risk-appropriate travel health frameworks are critically needed for future pandemic-era mega-events.
en.public_health_relevance: The discussion identifies operational gaps in managing transmissible disease threats during high-density international tourism and sports tournaments.
en.limitations: The manuscript relies on theoretical policy analysis without presenting original data collection or clinical trial results. Furthermore, the referenced viral pathogen currently lacks authorized prophylactic or therapeutic interventions.
en.gids_interpretation: Within the GIDS analytical framework, this document serves as a situational awareness resource that flags regulatory inconsistencies and advocates for harmonized operational guidelines during transnational health emergencies.

articles.title: Arboviral risk at Brazilian tourist destinations

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在明确登革热、基孔肯雅热和黄热病在巴西不同地理区域的分布特征与相对风险，并评估这些高风险地带与热门旅游目的地的空间重叠程度。
zh.study_design: 采用基于国家公共卫生监测系统的回顾性生态学研究设计。研究将实验室确诊的病例与死亡数据按中等地理区域进行汇总，并通过整合传播持续时间与发病率及死亡率四分位数构建综合风险评分模型。
zh.population_setting: 数据覆盖巴西全国范围内的中等地理区域，重点聚焦于本国常住居民及国际游客频繁往行的行政与自然地理单元。
zh.main_findings: 登革热在全国各区域均有检出，高风险区集中于中西部潘塔纳尔地带。基孔肯雅热同样广泛分布，但最高风险带与东北部如累西腓等海滨旅游热点高度重合。黄热病仅在三成余的区域出现，主要局限于东南部包括圣保罗州在内的地带。综合评分体系成功绘制出三种病毒差异化的空间风险图谱。
zh.public_health_relevance: 该空间整合评估工具可为旅行医学从业者提供直观的参考依据，辅助制定个性化的行前健康咨询与免疫规划。它揭示了不同旅游目的地所面临的虫媒病毒感染威胁存在显著的地域异质性。
zh.limitations: 摘要未直接声明具体局限性，但研究完全依赖上报的监测数据，可能受各地诊断能力差异或潜在漏报因素影响。综合风险指标为宏观聚合结果，未纳入个体出行行为或微观环境暴露变量。
zh.gids_interpretation: 本文属于描述性地理信息整理工作，侧重于将历史病例与死亡统计转化为可视化框架。其定位为建立区域性病毒活动基线参考，而非生成实时预警信号或验证现行监测网络的运行状态。

articles.title: Transmission pathways and risk factors for sporadic salmonellosis and campylobacteriosis: a source attribution meta-analysis of European case-control studies.

en.research_question: What are the primary transmission routes and attributable sources for sporadic campylobacteriosis and salmonellosis across European populations?
en.study_design: A Bayesian meta-analytical framework was utilized to combine population attributable fractions extracted from multiple European case-control investigations spanning two decades.
en.population_setting: Participants comprised individuals diagnosed with sporadic infections alongside matched controls recruited from Western and Northern European healthcare settings.
en.main_findings: Dietary and aquatic exposures accounted for nearly fifty percent of infections, with poultry products representing the dominant reservoir for Campylobacter and both poultry and pork contributing substantially to Salmonella cases. Incorporating direct animal interactions raised the zoonotic contribution to approximately sixty percent, while environmental factors explained roughly ten percent. The remaining portion of cases correlated with international travel, preexisting medical conditions, pharmaceutical interventions, interpersonal contact, and workplace activities.
en.public_health_relevance: Identifying dominant reservoirs and exposure routes supports targeted prevention strategies and resource allocation for enteric pathogen control across European health systems.
en.limitations: The synthesis relies exclusively on aggregated data from previously published case-control investigations, which may introduce variability in how exposure categories were defined and reported across different regions.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication offers a synthesized overview of historical attribution patterns for two major bacterial enteritides, serving as a reference point for transmission ecology rather than reflecting active outbreak detection or real-time epidemiological tracking.

zh.research_question: 欧洲散发性空肠弯曲菌病与沙门氏菌病的主要传播途径及危险因素是什么？
zh.study_design: 该研究采用贝叶斯框架下的荟萃分析方法，整合了多项欧洲病例对照研究的归因分数数据。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象涵盖西欧与北欧国家在二零零零年至二零二一年间开展的病例对照试验中的患者与健康对照者。
zh.main_findings: 食物与水源传播约占病例总数的一半，其中家禽产品是主要传染源。结合动物接触因素后，约六成感染可归因于人畜共患途径。其余四分之一病例则与旅行史、基础疾病用药、人际传播及职业暴露相关。
zh.public_health_relevance: 该分析通过量化不同传播途径的贡献比例，为区域性疾病防控重点提供依据。
zh.limitations: 数据仅来源于西欧和北欧地区，可能无法代表其他地理区域的流行特征。此外，纳入的研究时间跨度较长，可能难以反映近期的流行病学变化。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献提供了特定区域内历史病原体归因模式的背景信息，侧重于学术综述而非实时监测信号评估。
